text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Olive-brown cropped jacket and matching knee skirt, white collared shirt, black knee boots.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Recreate ONLY the large central-right woman outfit in the ORIGINAL reference, not the small runway inset above her: olive-brown washed hip-length single-breasted jacket with flap pockets, white shirt, matching olive-brown ABOVE-KNEE straight skirt, black knee boots. Remove neck scarf/tie/bow, belt and bag. No reference inset. Pure-white realistic EMPTY garment product photo. Do not use the long brown skirt of the small upper-right inset. Pure white seamless background, soft studio light, realistic materials, full uncropped portrait 2:3 1024x1536. No person, skin, anatomical body parts, visible mannequin, stand, labels, text, insets, collage or watermark. Change only the listed issues; preserve all remaining image details.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
